root_ordering.note: The X6C flat index is z*(47*47)+y*47+x. Chunk timing therefore primarily tracks z slabs, not x slabs.

spatial_certifiability.interpretation: There are strong axis-aligned effects, especially on z, but an additive x+y+z band model explains only about 24.7% of certifiability variance; simple triplane-band causation is therefore not established.

frozen_field_center_diagnostics.interpretation: Poor certifiability is strongly associated with small |f(center)| and lower pre-LayerNorm feature sigma. Center sigma is not near epsilon, so a literal near-zero-variance singularity is not demonstrated; interval variance lower-bound inflation remains a plausible mechanism and needs direct instrumentation.

source_visual_hull_proxy.artifact: NB1 MC_R512 ZERO_SURFACE generated from F4_SOURCE_FIELD_R512
source_visual_hull_proxy.meaning: 8-view source-silhouette signed-distance intersection, not the learned IRIS signed field
source_visual_hull_proxy.warning: The R512 source-hull mesh cannot be used as a zero-set soundness oracle for C0 certificates of the learned IRIS field. It is suitable as source-support evidence only, with an explicit calibration/pixel-dilation contract.

distance_diagnostic.distance_reference: nearest vertex of the source-silhouette R512 visual-hull mesh; diagnostic proxy only
distance_diagnostic.interpretation: Certifiability improves away from source geometry at first but degrades again in the farthest region; geometric distance alone does not explain bound tightness.

learned_field_aligned_lattice_red_team.grid: 189^3 vertices over the exact X6C micro2 leaf lattice (188^3 cells)
learned_field_aligned_lattice_red_team.note: This is the correct learned-field near-surface soundness diagnostic family. A source-hull MC vertex test is not.
